## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: very weak breadth plus narrow leadership concentration (Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology)), and MAJOR divergence among large caps (MSFT, AMZN, MA) — reduce conviction and watch for trend breaks.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leading: MPC ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%), VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.77% | 1M: +13.79%), CVX ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +5.83%). Technology shows pockets of strength: INTU ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%), NOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%). Communication modestly positive on 1W: SHOP ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.84% | 1M: +14.19%) is a notable contributor.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials weak: CRH BELOW TREND (1W: -11.00% | 1M: -13.15%), FCX BELOW TREND (1W: -12.81% | 1M: -4.04%), PPG BELOW TREND (1W: -13.44% | 1M: -14.80%). Consumer Staples weak: EL BELOW TREND (1W: -15.30% | 1M: -22.24%), MNST BELOW TREND (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%). Healthcare soft: LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -10.40%), UNH CORRECTION (1W: -2.32% | 1M: +3.83%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTU ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%), NOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%), PLTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +12.63%), MPC ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%), PANW RECOVERY (1W: +10.83% | 1M: -1.00%). Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — caution flag on concentration.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ASML BELOW TREND (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%), CRH BELOW TREND (1W: -11.00% | 1M: -13.15%), MNST BELOW TREND (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%), UPS BELOW TREND (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -11.10%), AMAT CORRECTION (1W: -12.77% | 1M: +9.26%). Weakness concentrated in Materials and select Tech equipment names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: INTU (1W: +17.64%), NOW (1W: +15.12%), PLTR (1W: +14.56%), MPC (1W: +11.64%), PANW (1W: +10.83%). Watch MA RECOVERY (1W: +0.99% | 1M: -5.63%), MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +4.13% | 1M: -1.04%) and AMZN RECOVERY (1W: +1.53% | 1M: -8.49%) — MAJOR divergence among large caps suggests tactical uncertainty, not a durable regime shift.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed with concentrated winners and notable losers; NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%), AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -6.80%), MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +4.13% | 1M: -1.04%), ASML BELOW TREND (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%), AMAT CORRECTION (1W: -12.77% | 1M: +9.26%). Sector shows internal rotation with concentrated leadership and headline-driven moves.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are soft on the week: JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -3.60% | 1M: -8.76%), V BELOW TREND (1W: -0.87% | 1M: -3.62%), WFC sentiment bullish but broader group is lagging; sector dynamics point to risk reduction rather than cyclical leadership. Sector weakness is confirmed in 1W results.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive names mixed and not leading: JNJ CORRECTION (1W: -3.23% | 1M: +3.07%), UNH CORRECTION (1W: -2.32% | 1M: +3.83%), LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -10.40%), PFE CORRECTION (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +1.01%). Healthcare showing weakness on 1W despite pockets of positive 1M performance — monitor for follow-through.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective Energy and high-conviction Tech winners (e.g., MPC ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%), INTU ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%)), reduce exposure to Materials and weak Consumer Staples names (EL BELOW TREND (1W: -15.30% | 1M: -22.24%)). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech concentration and weak overall breadth; monitor large-cap divergences before adding broad risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTU ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) — news confirmed (Anthropic deal); MPC ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) — energy momentum; NOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%). BEARISH: ASML BELOW TREND (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%), AMAT CORRECTION (1W: -12.77% | 1M: +9.26%), LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -10.40%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (Energy part of the 3/11 positive sectors; MPC, VLO strong on 1W). BEARISH: Materials and Consumer Staples (Materials worst on 1W: -6.92%; Consumer Staples down -5.38% 1W). Monitor Technology for leadership concentration and potential reversal.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA: monitor break above recent 1W highs (ABOVE TREND confirmation) for broader tech follow-through. AAPL: monitor 1M low area for trend continuation risk (AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -6.80%)). INTU: watch for sustained trading above the weekly surge to confirm accumulation (INTU ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%)). MPC: watch retention of 1W gains as energy leadership signal (MPC ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%)).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
INTU (+75): strong Q2, dividend hike and Anthropic AI deal — price action confirms (INTU ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%)). EA (+85): large buyout chatter — watch for deal flow impact; price action needs confirmation. WFC (+80): Fed consent order exit narrative — sentiment bullish and should be monitored against actual capital actions.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PYPL (-70): lawsuits and CEO exit — sentiment VERY BEARISH; cross-ref price action weakness should be monitored. ORCL (-60): layoffs / AI spend concerns — bearish headline that aligns with recent weakness in some enterprise names. RCL (-60): softer 2026 outlook — confirms near-term operational risk in travel-exposed names.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow Tech concentration and weak breadth (Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive). INTU ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%), MPC ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%), NOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) are showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR divergence among large caps (MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +4.13% | 1M: -1.04%), AMZN RECOVERY (1W: +1.53% | 1M: -8.49%), MA RECOVERY (1W: +0.99% | 1M: -5.63%)) and headline-driven negative sentiment on PYPL/ORCL — monitor for trend confirmation before broad increases in exposure.
